expected_outcomes: Every surface reports one truthful activation state and receipt.
required_actions: Detect the surface, validate sources and runtime capability, classify activation, and fall back without inventing state.
acceptance: Runtime, project simulation, chat simulation, instruction-only, unavailable, and not-verified states remain distinct.
verification: Validate source-pack hashes and inspect runtime capability where locally available.
failure_conditions: Links or instructions are presented as runtime execution or browser memory is claimed canonical.
